posts.title: Wrong Ways To Create Strings
posts.description: I’m on my way back from RustLab 2026, where I gave a lightning talk about all the ways to create a String in Rust that don’t involve String::new . The talks were not recorded, so I decided to write it up as a blog post. posts.title: Why I Still Believe in Mentorship
posts.description: One of the best tips I ever got was from my table tennis coach. He watched me play and said, “You are leaning forward with the wrong foot!” I’d been playing for years and thought I had a good stance. posts.title: Advice to Young Developers
posts.description: Someone recently asked me what advice I’d give to a young developer today. My answer had surprisingly little to do with code. Here’s what I’d focus on: Learn How to Build Products Even if LLMs write most of the code, there is still a need for problem solvers who can understand user needs, design solutions, and iterate based on feedback. No matter the technology, this skill will always be valuable.
